name: facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/eft.run_eft_fitting: run EFT fitting on all samples in the training dataset and export results as pickle files
facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/eft.run_smplify_fitting: run SMPLify optimization on all samples in the dataset using weak perspective projection and 2D keypoints
facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/eft.run_eft_step: run a single EFT training step with 2D and 3D keypoint loss on a batch of images
facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/eft.run_eft_step_with_hand: run a single EFT training step that includes 3D hand joint loss for SMPL-X hand fitting
facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/eft.compute_3d_keypoint_loss: compute the 3D keypoint reconstruction loss for Panoptic DB body and hand joints with confidence weighting

facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/fit.create_FitsDict: create a FitsDict instance to track best SMPL pose fits per image in the training set
facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/fit.save_FitsDict: save the FitsDict state to disk as numpy arrays in the checkpoint directory
facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/fit.retrieve_FitsDict_getitem: retrieve pose, betas, and validity tensors from the FitsDict for a batch of images
facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/fit.update_FitsDict_setitem: update FitsDict entries with new pose and betas parameters after undoing flip and rotation
facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/fit.flip_pose_SMPL: flip SMPL pose parameters by permuting joints and negating axis-angle dimensions for mirrored images

facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/tra.train_human_mesh_recovery: run the Trainer train_step method to perform a training iteration with SMPL parameter prediction and backpropagation
facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/tra.compute_2d_keypoint_loss: compute the 2D reprojection loss on predicted keypoints weighted by openpose and ground truth confidence scores
facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/tra.compute_3d_keypoint_loss: compute the 3D keypoint loss for examples with valid 3D pose annotations using pelvis-centered coordinates
facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/tra.run_evaluation_test: run the test method to evaluate the trained model on a dataset and return reconstruction error in millimeters
facebookresearch_eft/bodymocap/train/tra.compute_smpl_parameter_loss: compute the SMPL pose and beta parameter regression loss using rotation matrix and MSE criteria
